newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank Leumi gets three offers for Africa Israel.
newsitem.headline: Bank Leumi gets three offers for Africa Israel.

text.p: Bank Leumi has received three offers for the purchase of a controlling stake in its subsidiary Africa Israel Investments, a bank spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"The bank is planning to enter into immediate negotiations in order to finalise the sale as quickly as possible," she said.
She would not disclose the identities of the bidders.
The stake, which includes the holdings of businessmen Mordechai Zisser and Eitan Wertheimer, is equal to 46.58 percent of equity and 54.2 percent of voting rights in Africa Israel.
The price the bank expects to receive is substantially above the minium of $330 million which was set at the time of the tender.
The tender is for Africa Israel without its insurance business, which will be spun off separately. Italian insurer Generali Spa will then take control of the insurance business.
Leumi, Israel's second-largest bank, must reduce its stake in Africa Israel to 25 percent to comply with Israeli banking reform that requires banks to reduce their non-bank assets.
Africa Israel has interests in real estate, construction, tourism and hotels.
